plan.vision: A compact application that implements hierarchy-aware memory management algorithms using sparse data structures and deterministic validation, addressing developer pain points in memory-constrained environments. Atomic milestones: 1) Implement HNSW graph for memory pattern analysis, 2) Develop memory allocation simulator with O(1) complexity guarantees, 3) Create cross-platform benchmarking framework with memory-aware test coverage.

memory_engine.py: def allocate_chunk(size: int, priority: float) -> bool

plan.lessons_learned: Uses memory-mapped files for pattern analysis and prioritizes algorithmic efficiency over OOP overhead, avoiding common pitfalls of verbose enterprise patterns and ensuring test coverage for critical path operations.
plan.commit_message: Implements quantum memory optimization algorithms with sparse data structures for developer memory management challenges

files_to_generate.instructions: Implement HNSW memory pattern engine with sparse matrix representation. Must include: 1) O(1) allocation using size-priority tuples 2) Graph-based pattern detection 3) Memory fragmentation analysis. Use scipy sparse matrices for storage.

Create memory allocation simulator with configurable workloads. Must support: 1) Random allocation patterns 2) Fragmentation stress tests 3) Allocation success rate tracking. Use numpy random module with seed for reproducibility.

Implement validation framework that executes all memory operations through test doubles. Must include: 1) Memory usage profiling 2) Allocation success rate validation 3) Fragmentation threshold checks. Use pytest fixtures for test isolation.

Create concise documentation with installation steps, project vision, and architecture diagram. Must include: 1) Memory optimization goals 2) Technical stack overview (pure Python, no dependencies) 3) Mermaid diagram of memory allocation flow.
Generate standard Python .gitignore file excluding: venv, .env, __pycache__, node_modules, and *.pyc.
Generate minimal requirements file containing only pytest and numpy.
Create shell script that sets up Python virtual environment with pinned dependencies and installs requirements.txt packages.

Implement pytest test suite covering all memory operations. Must include: 1) Test for allocation success rates 2) Fragmentation threshold validation 3) Memory usage profiling. Use pytest parametrize for different workloads.
